items.new_text: Given a release that merges its own request without a person, when the request is merged, then the code host's own merge settings decide how (a merge commit when the code host allows one) and the merge goes through only while the request still holds exactly the checked release; and when the main line gained other work after the release was prepared and the chosen way of merging would fold that work into the release, then nothing is merged and the operator is told to start the release again.
